title: Ladybug reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body (red shell) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#e83030'/>
  <!-- Shell line -->
  <line x1='50' y1='52' x2='50' y2='92' stroke='#9e1010' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Dots on shell -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='64' r='3.5' fill='#3a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='64' r='3.5' fill='#3a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='78' r='3.5' fill='#3a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='78' r='3.5' fill='#3a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='86' r='3' fill='#3a1a1a'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='14' fill='#2a1a2e'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#fff8e0'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#fff8e0'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='42' r='1.8' fill='#3a2a30'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='42' r='1.8' fill='#3a2a30'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M45 49 Q50 54 55 49' stroke='#e8a0a0' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Antennae -->
  <path d='M42 32 Q36 22 30 18' stroke='#2a1a2e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 32 Q64 22 70 18' stroke='#2a1a2e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='18' r='2.5' fill='#e83030'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='18' r='2.5' fill='#e83030'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <path d='M32 62 Q24 58 20 62' stroke='#2a1a2e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 72 Q22 70 18 76' stroke='#2a1a2e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 62 Q76 58 80 62' stroke='#2a1a2e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 72 Q78 70 82 76' stroke='#2a1a2e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Book -->
  <g transform='translate(50,58)'>
    <!-- Left page -->
    <path d='M-2 -1 L-16 4 L-16 18 L-2 13 Z' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
    <!-- Right page -->
    <path d='M2 -1 L16 4 L16 18 L2 13 Z' fill='#fffaf0'/>
    <!-- Page shading -->
    <path d='M-2 -1 L-16 4 L-16 6 L-2 1 Z' fill='#e0d8c8'/>
    <path d='M2 -1 L16 4 L16 6 L2 1 Z' fill='#eee6d6'/>
    <!-- Spine -->
    <line x1='0' y1='-1' x2='0' y2='13' stroke='#c8a040' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <!-- Text lines left -->
    <line x1='-13' y1='6' x2='-5' y2='4' stroke='#b0a890' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='-13' y1='9' x2='-5' y2='7' stroke='#b0a890' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='-13' y1='12' x2='-5' y2='10' stroke='#b0a890' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <!-- Text lines right -->
    <line x1='5' y1='4' x2='13' y2='6' stroke='#b0a890' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='5' y1='7' x2='13' y2='9' stroke='#b0a890' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='5' y1='10' x2='13' y2='12' stroke='#b0a890' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <!-- Book edges -->
    <path d='M-16 4 L-16 18' stroke='#d0c8b0' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
    <path d='M16 4 L16 18' stroke='#d0c8b0' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Little hands holding book -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='66' r='3' fill='#2a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='66' r='3' fill='#2a1a2e'/>
</svg>
